fix: bigger keyboard buttons (48px, 7-col grid), smaller hangman canvas

4 rows of 7 letters instead of 9-col grid. Buttons are 48px tall with
1rem font — easy to tap on phones. Hangman drawing shrinks to fill
remaining space above keyboard. 99/99 on auditor.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: bump @freegamestore/games to v0.4.0 (Manrope topbar)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: responsive layout — canvas flexes, keyboard fits all viewports

Canvas fills available space (flex-1) instead of fixed 280px.
Keyboard uses 9-col grid with aspect-square buttons instead of
44px min-size flex-wrap. Everything fits 320x568 portrait and
568x320 landscape. Auditor: 99/99.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
